expected_findings.rationale: Caffeine and taurine are not among the listed allergens in regulation 5(14); this product has no allergen from that list.
Caffeine is an added ingredient but no CONTAINS CAFFEINE statement appears on the label.

trap: A system that only checks the allergen list may treat this ingredient list as fully compliant, missing that caffeine triggers a separate Schedule II warning requirement distinct from allergens.
notes: Tests the warning-trigger detection path, which is structurally different from the allergen path even though both key off ingredient keywords.
